page.overview:
Who is Wapol?

"Tin-Plate" Wapol is the king of the South Blue's Evil Black Drum Kingdom and president of , an international toy conglomerate and .

Originally king of the Grand Line's Drum Island, Wapol fled when the Blackbeard Pirates attacked (spending some time as the "captain" of his own, improvised pirate crew) and was permanently deposed by the Straw Hat Pirates soon after. However, his chance creation of a unique "miracle" alloy allowed him to rebuild as a toy manufacturer, winning wealth and power anew and eventually securing his current kingdom with the world-famous Kinderella as consort. After accidentally witnessing the Five Elders and Imu assassinating King Nefertari Cobra at the latest Levely, he went into hiding aboard "Big News" Morgans' airship alongside Nefertari Vivi.

He is the main antagonist of the Drum Island Arc (and by extension the ninth movie). He is also the protagonist of the Wapol's Omnivorous Hurrah cover arc.

Wapol is an overweight man with an unusual appearance. He has dark violet hair and a cylinder-shaped jaw made up of tin plates, hence his epithet. When Wapol uses his Slim-Up technique, he "eats" his body and becomes slim. During the Drum Island Arc, he used to dress in tin-plate armor and a hooded cape made from White Walkie skin. He was also wearing brown thick gloves. He spotted a pair of purple and orange woolen shorts and a brown belt around his waist and a pair of thick short boots. When he was the ruler of the Drum Peak, he was wearing the same attire but the tin-plate armor. Instead, he was wearing a grey shirt, and his gloves had no fur on their upper edge.
